summary: Prestwick Radar reduced flow rate due to a single controller; aircraft using Prestwick as an alternate may face delays.
text:
PRESTWICK RADAR REDUCED FLOW RATE DUE ATC SINGLE CONTROLLER. ACFT 
WISHING TO USE PRESTWICK AS AN ALTN MAY EXPERIENCE DELAYS. ALL ACFT 
INBOUND TO MONITOR 121.5MHZ AS MANDATED.
